scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.format: npm run format -w apps/api && npm run format -w apps/web && prettier --write e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w apps/api && npm run format:check -w apps/web && prettier --check e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:cov -w apps/api && npm run test:cov -w apps/web
